title: Converge routing variants and evacuate legacy admin flows
creator: Arjun Patel
description:
Goal: Reduce operational surface area by consolidating multiple legacy routing variants and removing historic admin endpoint shims that route to v0/v1 artifacts. This ticket targets three related pain points: (1) multiple runtime route variants that differ only by legacy query params, (2) admin endpoints that still proxy to deprecated rollouts, and (3) flag ingestion paths that duplicate state across stores.

Scope of work:
- Introduce a single canonical route manifest for runtime requests and migrate alias mappings to translation rules executed at config-push time.
- Replace live admin shims with small compatibility adapters that emit deprecation telemetry and short TTL redirects for one release cycle; then remove entirely.
- Migrate legacy flag transports to the canonical featureflag ingestion pipeline and remove dual-write paths.
- Add observability: per-route deprecated-hit counters, rollout-fallback rates, and a dashboard to track migration progress.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Customer-facing routes could see 5xx spikes during cutover. Mitigation: Canary apply with traffic steering and automated rollback; preserve fallback to previous behavior for 48 hours.
- Risk: Flag state divergence during migration. Mitigation: Read-after-write comparisons and a reconciliation job with compensating writes.

Success criteria and acceptance tests are listed below.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical route manifest published and adopted by router service
Legacy admin shims replaced by adapters that return deprecation header and log telemetry
No dual-write flag paths remain; ingestion pipeline has authoritative flag writer
Migration dashboard shows <1% error delta and rollout-fallback rate below 0.5% for two consecutive days
Performance: p95 latency for common runtime routes unchanged (±5%) after cutover
Rollback plan validated in staging and runbook updated in runbooks/route-migration.md
implementation_steps: Stage 1: Add canonical route manifest schema and implement translation at config-push time (runtime-config service change)
Stage 2: Deploy admin adapters behind feature flag (admin-proxy), collect telemetry for two weeks
Stage 3: Turn on canonical routing for 10% of traffic with automated canary checks
Stage 4: Drain legacy aliases and remove transport dual-write in flag-ingest service
Stage 5: Ramp to 100% and remove adapters in next minor release
Stage 6: Run reconciliation job, close migration dashboard, archive temporary telemetry indices
notes: Spike PR implementing canonical manifest parser: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1289
